text: beet
A fake herb-like vegetable widely cultivated for humans and livestock alike, notably nutritious and historically used in dye making.
eggplant
A fake bulbous purple fruit of the nightshade family. Eggplant is rarely served as a side, generally filling the role of the main component of the dish.
cabbage
A fake somewhat hardy, leafy green vegetable, often chopped and then fermented or stewed.
onion
A fake edible bulb of pungent, savory taste and smell with almost as many varieties as cooking applications.
pea
Fake spherical green seeds tucked safely away in a fleshy pod. Pea plants are known to be quite thirsty, and will benefit greatly from rainfall.
pepper
Fake, tiny, spicy, crimson pods often used in sauces, relishes, or powders.
pumpkin
Technically a giant berry, pumpkins are renowned for being trivial to both sow and harvest. These ones are fake.
tomato
A series of juicy, glossy red fruits attached by vine, used commonly as a vegetable. These ones are fake.
apple tree
A fake tree bearing glossy, red apples, while a myriad of different varieties exist this particular type favors warm summers and mild winters.
peach tree
A fake deciduous tree bearing fuzzy, stone fruit known as peaches, peach trees often require full sunlight and warm temperatures.
cherry tree
A fake tree bearing tiny purple-red sweet cherries.
plum tree
A fake bushy tree bearing a smooth-skinned purple fruit.
pear tree
A fake stout tree bearing crispy green pears, pear trees are notable for requiring high amounts of water and cool weather, and also doing quite well in shade.
opuntia
More often referred to as the “prickly pear” cactus, this plant is known to be quite bountiful even in hot, dry deserts. This one is fake.
bearberry bush
A low-lying bush speckled with pink berries that thrives in poor, even sandy soil. This one is fake.
banana tree
A fake, broad-leafed, tall tropical tree adorned with a cluster of yellow, elongated berries succinctly known as bananas.
orange tree
A fake, bushy, semi-tropical tree dotted with orange fruits well equipped for growing in humid environments and in wet soil.
